description: A base support officer must allocate 18 portable climate-control units among the clinic, communications annex, dining facility, and motor pool, set the issue start time, and record the coordination actions needed for installation.

shared_context.S1: The base received 18 portable climate-control units for temporary use during the coming week.
shared_context.S2: The units must be allocated among the clinic, communications annex, dining facility, and motor pool.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Lawson publishes the allocation and installation plan for the base support section.
shared_context.S4: The base support section holds its routine weekly facilities huddle before publishing such plans, and the clinic, signal, dining, and motor-pool representatives are expected to report current operating requirements at that huddle.

PF1.text: The clinic's vaccine refrigerator support assessment, confirmed by the medical maintenance technician this morning, requires exactly 6 climate-control units in the clinic treatment and storage areas; the signed assessment is still in the clinic file and has not been entered on the base support worksheet.

PF2.text: The communications annex electrical inspection, completed this morning, limits that building to exactly 3 portable climate-control units without overloading its temporary circuit; Lt. Okafor has the inspection note, but the facilities tracker has not yet been updated.

PF3.text: The dining facility's food-storage and meal-service review confirmed a requirement for exactly 4 climate-control units during the week; SFC Miller received the signed review today, but it is not yet attached to the common facilities request.

PF4.text: The motor pool's overnight maintenance plan requires exactly 5 climate-control units for the enclosed work bays, and installation must begin at Monday 0700; WO1 Patel confirmed both details with the maintenance control desk this morning, but the revised work plan has not yet reached base support.

acceptance_conditions: The clinic must receive exactly 6 climate-control units.
The communications annex must receive exactly 3 climate-control units.
The dining facility must receive exactly 4 climate-control units.
The motor pool must receive exactly 5 climate-control units.
The installation issue must begin Monday at 0700.
The plan must include coordination for clinic installation, communications circuit validation, dining-facility placement, and motor-pool installation.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'clinic_installation_coordination' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'communications_circuit_validation' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'dining_placement_coordination' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'motor_pool_installation_coordination' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The clinic assessment changes the clinic allocation from an uninformed default to exactly 6 units and requires clinic installation coordination.
The electrical inspection changes the communications-annex allocation to exactly 3 units and requires a circuit-validation action.
The food-storage review changes the dining-facility allocation to exactly 4 units and requires coordination for placement there.
The motor-pool work plan changes that allocation to exactly 5 units, fixes installation to Monday 0700, and requires motor-pool installation coordination.
